title: POPANE-R2 Independent Future-Change Valence Attack
classification: Exploratory/post-primary adversarial replication. POPANE-R1 level outcomes are known; no POPANE change-target outcome has been inspected. Frozen before O002-D1 change outcome is known.
purpose: Test whether peripheral physiology predicts future changes/deviations in valence even though it failed to improve absolute level forecasts over persistence.
reuse_from_r1: Identical file inclusion and technical QC.
Identical 10 s anchors and common rows supporting all horizons.
Identical predictor windows, physiological feature extraction, subject folds, joint held-person × held-segment evaluation, Ridge/HGB specifications, imputation/scaling and privacy rules.

change_target.definition: delta_y = future target mean affect at each horizon minus prior_affect mean in [-5,-1] s at predictor anchor.
change_target.physiology_model: context features + all predeclared R1 physiology features

endpoints.primary: delta_context_phys = MAE(context)-MAE(physiology). Positive favors physiology for change prediction beyond prior level/time.
endpoints.secondary: delta_zero_phys = MAE(zero-change)-MAE(physiology). Positive means physiology beats the parameter-free no-change forecast.
endpoints.uncertainty: Participant-cluster bootstrap, 5000 replicates per horizon and learner.

decisions.CLEAR_EXTERNAL_CHANGE_SIGNAL: At least one horizon has BOTH Ridge and HGB delta_context_phys 95% CI strictly above zero.
decisions.NO_EXTERNAL_CHANGE_INCREMENT: No horizon has delta_context_phys 95% CI strictly above zero for either learner.
decisions.STRONG_ZERO_CHANGE_DOMINANCE: For all four horizons and both learners, delta_zero_phys mean <=0 and no delta_zero_phys CI is strictly above zero.

interpretation: If CLEAR_EXTERNAL_CHANGE_SIGNAL, physiology may predict transitions even when it does not improve level forecasts; level-forecast result stands but manuscript claim must narrow.
If NO_EXTERNAL_CHANGE_INCREMENT, the strongest transition-based rescue fails in independent data as well.
This is post-primary exploratory evidence and cannot be described as preregistered confirmation.
firewalls: No claim of physiological causal irrelevance.
